newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major says election there to be won.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major says election there to be won.

text.p: Britain's ruling Conservative Party could still win Thursday's election despite opinion polls showing a Labour lead, Conservative Prime Minister John Major said.
"I believe this election is there to be won," he said on BBC radio.
Opinion polls suggest the opposition Labour party will take power for the first time in 18 years.
"I don't share the opinion...that we're going to lose tomorrow. I think this election is there to be won. There are huge numbers of people who are undecided.
"There are also lots of people who are undeclared...and I believe we are going to win."
